name: Water well drilling
summary: Finished water wells priced from depth by formation, casing, grout, pump system, trench and mobilization.

items.label: Drill overburden (soil, clay, gravel)
items.source: DEFAULTS (calc.mjs): overburdenFt 40, 1 / overburdenFtPerHour 25 rig h/ft, overburdenCostFt $6; rig hours priced at rigRate $185 (rig, compressor and crew)

items.label: Drill rock
items.source: DEFAULTS: depthFt 250 - 40 overburden = 210 ft; 1 / rockFtPerHour 12 rig h/ft; rockCostFt $11

items.label: Pitless adapter, pump, pressure tank and install
items.source: DEFAULTS pitlessCost $380 + pumpCost $1,450 + tankCost $520 + pumpInstallHours 4 x installRate $90 (install crew is a separate $90/h cost, folded in as dollars so it is not billed at the $185 rig rate)

items.label: Trench, water line and wire to house
Permit, well log and water test

specialistModels: Adds a dry-hole allowance (8% chance x drilling, casing, move, permit and $600 abandonment), plus depth and dry-risk price ladders; wage is the $185 rig-hour rate with no burden, setupHours is rig setup/development and tripFee is mobilization.
